description: Write a number in Vietnamese and English words, for an invoice or a receipt: 1.250.000 becomes "một triệu hai trăm năm mươi nghìn" and "one million two hundred fifty thousand". A dot or comma before exactly three digits groups thousands (1.250, 12,500); before other digits it is the decimal mark (12,5 or 2.75). Free; the Vietnamese money line is included.

chan.description: End a whole money line with "chẵn". Default true.

four.description: Read 24 as "hai mươi tư" (tu) or "hai mươi bốn" (bon).

money.description: Include the Vietnamese money line (đồng). Default true.

number.description: The number to read, like "1.250.000", "1250000" or "12,5".

zero.description: The word for a missing tens digit: "linh" or "lẻ".

name: number_to_words
title: Write a number in words
